content: Maaron ileep tomania Yosep izi Isip
Yes Ismaela tigham Yosep gha tizila tivot Isip, ra tigholia imin besooŋa sorok ila to Potipar. Potipar, i uraata ee to kinik to Isip. I daaba to yes zaaba tau tiŋgin kinik ruum tooni.

Yoova ilepleep tomania Yosep, ve ighurghur poia tooni izazaa tooni. Tauvene uraat tooni tau i ighamghamu izi ruum to Potipar na, ilaan poia mon. Potipar ighita ighe Maaron ileep tomania Yosep, ve iuluule le uraat tooni isov ilaan poia. Tauvene Potipar loolo pani, ve ighuru imin ŋginiiŋ pa ruum tooni, tomania gabua tooni naol isov.
Saawe tana ve ila, Maaron ighur poia tooni izaa to Potipar, tomania ruum, ŋgai, uum, ve gabua tooni naol isov. Pasaa, Yosep ndaamo pani.

Tauvene Potipar ipul gabua tooni naol isov ila Yosep niima to iŋgin zi, ve maata ila pani muul mako. Aniiŋ tau i tauu ighani, tane mon ta Potipar iŋgini. Yosep iyooz ariaaŋ pa tovaaŋ Yosep, i ŋeer ee. Tumbuuŋ tooni tomania naagho, ene paghuuna kat.
Saawe ee, Potipar azaawa ighan maata pani, ighe itoova. Tauvene imbuura ighe yesuru tigheen.

Eemon Yosep ilooŋa mako, ve iyol aliiŋa ighe: “Ee-e, vene mako. Pa tiina tsiau Potipar, i inumeer ghau kat. Tauta ipul gabua tooni naol isov tau tigheen ila ruum tooni loolo ne ila nimag, ve maata ila pani muul mako.

Yau namin daaba pa ruum tane imin i tauu. Ve yo mon, ta i iŋgalsekin ghau payo. Gabua ite paam mako. Pasaa, i azaawa yo. Isaav ighe nataghon aliŋam ve nagham ŋgar saghati tane, pale poia? Mako. Ene pale nagham sosor tiina ila Maaron maata.”
Saawe naol, Potipar azaawa inoknok mburaaŋ Yosep ighe yesuru tigheen. Eemon Yosep ilooŋa mako. Ve ila igharauu paam mako.
Tilepleep le saawe ee, Yosep iloŋ ila ruum loolo ighe igham uraat tooni. Ve saawe tana besooŋa ite paam ileep mako.
Tauvene Potipar azaawa ilaagh ŋaruini ila, ituuk pa nonoghiiŋa tooni, ve isaav pani ighe: “Aa, ulam gha ituru tagheen lak!” Eemon Yosep ipul nonoghiiŋa tooni tawe izi, ve ighau ivot ila muuri.
Potipar azaawa ighita Yosep ipul nonoghiiŋa tooni igheen ila i niima, ve ighau ivot ila pa muuri.

Tauvene iboob pa besooŋa siriv tilam, ve isaav pazi ighe: “Ai, aghita gabua tane! Azuwag igham Hibru tamazi tawe ilam ileep tomani ghiit, ve aazne i igham mayaŋa tiina kat pait. Pasaa, i ilam ighe imogheer payau. Eemon yau naboob aliŋag tiina, tauta iroi gha ipul nonoghiiŋa tooni tane izi, ve ighau ivot ila muuri.”
Ra ikis nonoghiiŋa to Yosep, ve isaŋan azaawa Potipar ilam.
Potipar ilam ivot, ve azaawa ipaes pani ighe: “Ai, Hibru tamazi tau yo ughamu ilam ileep tomani ghiit ne, i igham mayaŋa tiina kat pait. Pasaa, i ilam ighe imogheer payau.
Eemon yau naboob aliŋag tiina, tauta iroi, ve ipul nonoghiiŋa tooni tane izi, ve ighau ivot ila muuri.
Ene ŋgar tau besooŋa tsio tawe igham payau.” Potipar ilooŋ saveeŋ tooni, le aate yavyav kat.
Tauvene ikis Yosep, ve ighuru iloŋ ila ruum to yavyavuuŋ. Ruum tawe, yes tau tizorzoor kinik aliiŋa na, tizeev zi tiloŋ tila.
Yosep ileep ila ruum to yavyavuuŋ loolo
Yosep ilepleep ila ruum to yavyavuuŋ loolo. Eemon Yoova ipuli mako. Ilepleep tomania, ve iuluule. Tauta daaba tau iŋgin ruum to yavyavuuŋ na loolo poia pa Yosep.
Ve ighuru to iŋgin zeetŋa siriv tau yesŋa tileep ila ruum to yavyavuuŋ loolo. Saa uraat tau ighe ivot, ene Yosep ighamgham pooz pani.
Daaba tau iŋgin ruum to yavyavuuŋ na, ipul uraat isov ila Yosep niima, ve maata ila pani muul mako. Pasaa, Yoova ilepleep tomania Yosep. Tauvene uraat isov tau Yosep ighamu, ene ilaan poia mon.
